title: SceneRhythmLedger Event
description: Append-only log of scene type sequence. Maintains a rolling window of the last 8–10 scene types to prevent rhythm monotony (e.g. 5 consecutive interiority scenes). Used by Outliner to enforce pacing variety. Rolling window is computed by LedgerManager as a view over this log.

chapter_number.description: Denormalized chapter number for window queries.

scene_type.description: Scene type classification. Genre modules may extend. Used for rolling-window monotony detection.

rolling_window.description: Snapshot of the last 8–10 scene types at the time this event was appended (computed by LedgerManager, stored for dashboard display without re-query).

rhythm_alert.description: True if LedgerManager detected a monotony violation in the rolling window at the time of this event.

rhythm_alert_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the rhythm alert (e.g. '4 consecutive interiority scenes'). Null if no alert.
